outcome: time intervals from labor induction to labor active phase and delivery
complications (fetal distress, placental abruption, meconium staining)
cohort: The study included 195 women with singleton pregnancies and unripe cervices.
finding: Extra-amniotic saline infusion (EASI) was found to be a safer and more effective method for cervical ripening compared to vaginal misoprostol and laminaria.
mod_finding: The rates of cesarean section were significantly higher in the misoprostol group.
